contrast_small_task: small task (k=9): dcs>0 3/6, mean -0.022 (ties). harder task (k=17): dcs>0 5/6, mean +0.042 -> regime confirmed
headline: HARDER-TASK: the coincidence-gated BDSP gives a WEAK but CONSISTENT positive transport-free credit signal on real spikes -- dcs>0 5/6, mean dcs +0.042 (BDSP 0.159 vs frozen 0.131), vs the small task 3/6 mean -0.022. REGIME HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED: when the reservoir FAILS (harder task, frozen 0.131 vs oracle 0.796), directed credit adds consistently. BUT weak (closes only ~4% of the frozen->oracle gap), overfits (train 0.669 vs heldout 0.159), shuffle-DFA load-bearing on only 4/6 -> not a GO, and the directed signal is not cleanly attributable on every seed. The FIRST consistent positive transport-free credit on real spikes; far from closing the gap.
